Error: refusing to serve 192.0.2.10:8787 over plain HTTP.
butterfly's built-in server has no TLS. Off loopback, the evidence -- which embeds the complete source text -- and any bearer token cross the network in clear: anyone on the path can read both, and replay the token to change review decisions.

Instead, either:
  * keep butterfly on loopback (--listen 127.0.0.1:8787) and forward the port from your own machine:
      ssh -N -L 8787:127.0.0.1:8787 <host>
  * or put a TLS-terminating reverse proxy in front of it. On the same host, keep butterfly on loopback and no flag is needed;
    on another host, pass --insecure-http to acknowledge the plain-HTTP hop between the proxy and butterfly.
